title: Bank Deposit Corridor Coverage and Purpose-of-Transfer Corridors
content:
A Bank Deposit tier pays only into the corridors it serves, and in certain corridors the purpose of the transfer must be stated at booking. A corridor is identified by its country and payout currency (for example MX-MXN is Mexico, Mexican peso).

## Corridors served by each tier

| Tier | Corridors served |
|---|---|
| Bank Deposit Economy | MX-MXN, GT-GTQ, SV-USD, HN-HNL, DO-DOP, CO-COP, PH-PHP, IN-INR, VN-VND, BD-BDT, NG-NGN, KE-KES, GH-GHS |
| Bank Deposit Standard | MX-MXN, GT-GTQ, SV-USD, HN-HNL, DO-DOP, CO-COP, PH-PHP, IN-INR, VN-VND, BD-BDT, NG-NGN, KE-KES, GH-GHS |
| Bank Deposit Express | MX-MXN, GT-GTQ, DO-DOP, CO-COP, PH-PHP, IN-INR, VN-VND, BD-BDT, NG-NGN, KE-KES, GH-GHS |
| Bank Deposit Express Plus | MX-MXN, GT-GTQ, DO-DOP, CO-COP, PH-PHP, IN-INR, VN-VND, BD-BDT, NG-NGN, KE-KES, GH-GHS |
| Bank Deposit Large Amount | MX-MXN, GT-GTQ, DO-DOP, CO-COP, PH-PHP, IN-INR, VN-VND |
| Bank Deposit International Wire | MX-MXN, GT-GTQ, SV-USD, HN-HNL, DO-DOP, CO-COP, PH-PHP, IN-INR, VN-VND, BD-BDT, NG-NGN, KE-KES, GH-GHS |

## Corridors where a transfer purpose must be stated

| Tier | Purpose-of-transfer corridors |
|---|---|
| Bank Deposit Economy | IN-INR, BD-BDT, NG-NGN, VN-VND |
| Bank Deposit Standard | IN-INR, BD-BDT, NG-NGN, VN-VND |
| Bank Deposit Express | IN-INR, BD-BDT, NG-NGN, VN-VND |
| Bank Deposit Express Plus | IN-INR, BD-BDT, NG-NGN, VN-VND |
| Bank Deposit Large Amount | MX-MXN, GT-GTQ, DO-DOP, CO-COP, PH-PHP, IN-INR, VN-VND |
| Bank Deposit International Wire | IN-INR, BD-BDT, NG-NGN, VN-VND |

## Points of reading

- El Salvador (SV-USD) and Honduras (HN-HNL) are served on Bank Deposit Economy, Bank Deposit Standard and Bank Deposit International Wire only; the two real-time tiers and Bank Deposit Large Amount do not pay into them.
- Bangladesh, Nigeria, Kenya and Ghana (BD-BDT, NG-NGN, KE-KES, GH-GHS) are not served by Bank Deposit Large Amount.
- On Bank Deposit Large Amount every corridor it serves is a purpose-of-transfer corridor; on every other tier the purpose corridors are India, Bangladesh, Nigeria and Vietnam.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a Bank Deposit Large Amount transfer to Colombia (CO-COP) is in a served corridor and a purpose must be stated; the same corridor on Bank Deposit Standard is served and no purpose is required at booking.
